title: Miami Combo: Everglades Adventure and Sightseeing Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Shared experience and shared transportation. Airboat rides and alligator shows are conducted in English. On-route commentary available in English / Spanish / German. Extended courtesy stops outside the free pickup zones may be possible; small supplement fee may apply.
Downtown Miami area pickup time - 7:45am. Miami Beach area pickup time - 8:00am
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the best of South Florida in one unforgettable day with an exciting combination of Everglades adventure and Miami city sightseeing. Feel the thrill of a classic airboat ride as you glide across the legendary Everglades, spotting alligators and native wildlife while exploring one of the world’s most unique ecosystems.

Then experience the vibrant energy of Miami as you tour its most iconic neighborhoods, including colorful Wynwood, lively Little Havana, glamorous South Beach, and the stunning Downtown skyline. Along the way, enjoy fascinating commentary, scenic views, and countless photo opportunities.

With comfortable transportation, guided experiences, wildlife encounters, and top Miami highlights all included, this tour is the perfect way to experience nature, culture, and city life in a single unforgettable adventure. Ideal for first-time visitors, families, couples, and anyone wanting to see more of Miami in one convenient day.
